_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Dir sidd Spiller {player_id} an engem Spill vu LinesOfAction.
Är Steng sinn '{side}', Géigner-Steng sinn '{other}'.
Zuch-Format: `[b1b3]` (vu-Koordinat op-Koordinat). E legale Zuch geet horizontal, vertikal oder diagonal eng Zuel vu Quadraten, déi der Zuel vu Steng (jee no Faarf) an där Linn entsprécht. Dir kënnt iwwer Är eegen Steng sprangen, awer net iwwer Géigner-Steng; wann Dir op en Géigner landt, da gëtt en gefaangen.  Gewonnen, wann all Är Steng 8-Noper-verbonden sinn.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: D'Bewegung muss direkt oder diagonal sinn.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Muss d'Distanz gläich bewegen wéi Stécker an der Linn.

game_action.captured_suffix: Spiller {player_id} huet {from} -> {to} beweegt an huet e feindleche Stéck gefaangen.
